first_installment_sketch: Modern Standby killed the browser workers. WE BELIEVED the workers were crashing. TEST: inspected the machine's power state. FALSIFICATION: the Pig's event log showed Modern Standby sleep destroying page targets, the third time the pattern hit. ROOT CAUSE: the AC sleep timer had silently reverted to 30 minutes. MINIMAL FIX: AC sleep set to Never, Modern Standby disabled in the registry, execution-scoped wake inhibition per automation pass. NEW INVARIANT: monitoring probes never fail closed on a transient, and the sleep state is now explicit in the machine's operating assumptions. Source: L6 directive section 2 falsification list.
